_comment: Importable GitHub repository ruleset. Apply to BOTH public repos:
Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> New ruleset -> Import a ruleset,
or:  gh api -X POST repos/OWNER/REPO/rulesets --input this-file.json
This is the only layer here that PREVENTS rather than DETECTS. It rejects
the push itself, server-side, so it holds against `git push --no-verify`,
against a fresh clone where nobody ran scripts/setup-dev.sh, and against a
clone where core.hooksPath was never set. The local hook and the PR
workflow are both bypassable; this is not.
Keep bypass_actors empty. An admin bypass would defeat the point, since
the people most likely to hold int/* branches locally are the admins.
int/* is canonical; internal/* is a blocked alias, present because this
repo has an internal/ directory and `internal/my-work` is the likeliest
wrong guess at the branch name. int-* and internal-* are NOT included:
they are not namespaces, and blocking them would catch ordinary branches
Does NOT belong on fairinternal/openapps-internal — those branches are
exactly what that repo is for.
name: block-internal-refs
